newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia wheat futures down in light trading.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia wheat futures down in light trading.

text.p: Sydney wheat futures switched direction on Wednesday, inching lower in light volume trading.
A lack of volume trading left nearby January and March wheat marginally lower. Grains traders said lower values in the United States overnight influenced local market sentiment.
Mounting indications from insurers that a hailstorm last Sunday may have caused severe damage to wheat and other crops in northern New South Wales failed to rattle prices.
Traders said the bearish tone in the U.S. was being compounded by expectations of a bumper wheat crop in Australia, with more growers coming to market at some point.
